channels.scope: Selected all-part empty-channel segments and measured actual wood-wall gaps. The two stone bearers deliberately block other downward segments; no claim of water transport or universal open drainage.

recesses.scope: True closed-material blind cups and fixed recessed pegs. Wood-only cup voids are intentionally occupied by those pegs; no working fastener or installation claim.

planarCaps.scope: Every actual used top/bottom planar-cap vertex normal. Separate bevel shading seams avoid cap fan artefacts without flattening the entire material.

roundedProfiles.scope: Finite actual rounded-rectangle bevel rings; not a continuous curvature, slip or weather guarantee.

diagnosticFloor.scope: Ten finite actual bearer-bottom/diagnostic-plane triangle pairs and authored lower half-space only; actual Scene placement, installed contact, load and stability remain separate.

audit.scope: One finite saved slatted panel assembly. Clear selected channels, intentionally blocked bearer segments, blind fixed peg recesses and diagnostic floor witnesses only. No hydrology, walking/navigation, installation, weather/load/slip, all-world/body or ordinary gameplay/ownership/save guarantee.

audit_vertex_counter_semantics: audit.actualStoredVertices is a legacy label for the sum of stored position counts traversed once per rendered Mesh, including shared-geometry instances. Distinct underlying storage is measured.unique_geometry_stored_vertices.

geometryIdentity.method: SHA256 explicit typed position/index layout and underlying bytes. Object storage, exact content and rendered part instances are distinct counts.

cameras.scope: 135 finite actual transformed per-Mesh vertex-instance projections plus8 separate real box corners. Shared geometry is not new storage/test credit. No continuous or occlusion/pixel guarantee.

probe.contactSupportKind: five actual bottom-triangle samples on each of two authored broad flat stone bearers

originalSpriteEnvelopeClearance.method: sphere enclosing all four full raw Sprite quad corners from actual world scale/center; sphere-to-conservative-3D-pose-envelope distance; includes faint/transparent corners without cropping

probe.buildingProxyScope: actual current place-group mesh AABBs only; not full building geometry or transparent original-art fixture volume clearance

meadowInstances.scope: every actual current meadow instance geometry AABB transformed by its actual instance and world matrix, expanded .018 in all axes; current finite matrices and authored animation allowance, no all-frame proof

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against entire boardwalk-panel XZ AABB

probe.limits: one fixed authored standalone boardwalk-panel pose at one synthetic current-default-world site;10 finite bearer-bottom/floor triangle pairs on two actual authored stone bearers,63 finite walkability samples and conservative current road, original-card, meadow, shore and building-proxy envelope clearances. These finite witnesses do not verify full bearer surface contact, actual installation/drainage/walking/navigation, support stability, load, physical behavior, body fit, whole-world placement or all-camera visibility

placement.Node_DOM_limitation: Actual existing winter Scene geometry only. Node does not decode browser image assets; actual browser originalArtready/post-art world baseline remains a separate native gate.
